attack_techniques: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Cloud Firewall (T1562.007)
attackers_goals: Bypass security controls to gain access to restricted resources within the Azure cloud environment.
description: An Azure firewall rule group was modified or deleted.
investigative_actions: Check the Azure Firewall rule configuration to identify the changes made. Verify whether the identity should be making this action.
name: An Azure firewall rule group was modified
